title: Count with a FOR loop
summary: PL/SQL: Count with a FOR loop. Count through 4.
introduction: A numeric FOR loop creates a counter and includes both ends.
learningObjectives: Count with a FOR loop with PL/SQL

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Count with a FOR loop

blocks.text: The numeric FOR loop creates n and includes values 1 through 3.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not assign a new value to the FOR loop counter.
